data_fields.name: pulse_count
data_fields.donor_constant: ceil(cast time / pulse interval); 0 = no pulse

data_fields.name: pose_action_per_spell
data_fields.donor_constant: SpellInfo.Action per spell; player-monster body uses action 12

best_idea: While a cast runs, re-send the wind-up pose at a fixed interval for ceil(cast time / interval) pulses, and stop the chain as soon as the cast is disturbed or superseded, so a one-shot pose never gets stuck.
decision_why: Take the pulse count, the guard before each pulse and the stop-on-disturb rule for a hero's charged special. Do not take the re-send unless the wind-up clip is one-shot: a looping clip needs no pulses. Disturb must be a server-verified state change, not a client timer.
acceptance: A charged special holds its wind-up pose for the whole charge; a disturbing hit (server-decided) stops the pose within one pulse interval; a server test shows the special is cancelled and no further pulse is requested.
